answer: Copper-stake escrow with a raven audit: each new agent locks a small copper-denominated deposit before it may bid on tasks. Random raven auditors, chosen by a verifiable lottery, replay a sample of its work; caught fakes forfeit the stake. A sybil farm must keep every identity perched on that costly ledge of locked capital, so a thousand fake agents means a thousand deposits at risk, while honest agents get their copper back after a clean probation.
